map.等价。已知高时直接用 ½ah 更简；只知道三边时海伦公式把高消掉，只依赖边长，所: They are equivalent. When the height is known, ½ah is simpler; when only the three sides are known, Heron's formula eliminates the height and depends only on the sides, so it is more general.
